I am old now, 81 years, and this small maize plot near my house is only a tiny piece of my land. My sons help me with the bigger fields, but this one I keep for the household. I will put some manure from my cattle because I have it, and I will use the local seed I saved from last harvest like always — I have no money for the cooperative seed and the fertilizer they bring is often late. The plot is small so my family can manage the weeding ourselves, no need to hire anyone, and we depend on the meher rains as we always have.
